area: CLAUDE.md, memory, rule files, path scoping, imports, /doctor, /init, managed CLAUDE.md, auto-memory

facts.behavior: Claude treats them as context, not enforced configuration. CLAUDE.md content is delivered as a user message after the system prompt, not as part of the system prompt itself... there's no guarantee of strict compliance, especially for vague or conflicting instructions. To block an action regardless of what Claude decides, use a PreToolUse hook.
facts.limits: Cannot guarantee compliance; for must-run steps (before every commit, after each edit) use hooks; --append-system-prompt for system-prompt level, better for scripts.
facts.citation: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md (CLAUDE.md vs auto memory; Claude isn't following my CLAUDE.md)

facts.behavior: Four scopes listed in load order, broadest to most specific: Managed policy; User (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md); Project (./CLAUDE.md or ./.claude/CLAUDE.md); Local (./CLAUDE.local.md, add to .gitignore). A project instruction appears in context after a user instruction.
facts.limits: Local file is not shared and only exists in the worktree where created (share across worktrees by importing a file from home dir).
facts.citation: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md (Choose where to put CLAUDE.md files)

facts.feature: Hierarchy loading at launch and concatenation
facts.behavior: Loads CLAUDE.md and CLAUDE.local.md from the current working directory and every directory above it. All discovered files are concatenated rather than overriding each other, ordered from filesystem root down to working directory; within a directory CLAUDE.local.md is appended after CLAUDE.md.
facts.limits: Conflicting instructions are not resolved; Claude may pick one arbitrarily.

facts.behavior: CLAUDE.md and CLAUDE.local.md in subdirectories under the working directory are not loaded at launch; each loads once Claude reads, writes, or edits another file in that subdirectory (including Bash cat/head on a single file that counts as a read). A 'Loaded' line with its path appears in the terminal. They do not appear under /context Memory files at launch.
facts.limits: Not loaded until a file in that subdirectory is touched. Per-file size limit applies (see on-demand size limit). Worktrees under .claude/worktrees/ have separate rules in the worktrees doc (not read here).
facts.citation: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md (How CLAUDE.md files load; Claude isn't following my CLAUDE.md)

facts.behavior: Target under 200 lines per CLAUDE.md file. Longer files consume more context and reduce adherence. If one instruction file is over the recommended length, you see a warning at startup and when you run /status; also a warning when files each within that length add up past a combined limit at session start. Each CLAUDE.md, rules file, and @path import counts as a separate file.
facts.limits: 200 lines is a recommendation; the warning does not truncate or block. Exact combined limit value not stated.
facts.citation: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md (Write effective instructions; My CLAUDE.md is too large)

facts.feature: CLAUDE.md hard size cap at launch (4 MiB)
facts.behavior: Claude gets the whole of each CLAUDE.md file that loads at launch, as long as the file is 4 MiB or smaller. Claude Code skips a file over 4 MiB and loads none of it.
facts.limits: Applies to launch-loaded files; the 200-line/25KB limit applies only to MEMORY.md.
facts.citation: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md (How it works note; My CLAUDE.md is too large)

facts.feature: On-demand file per-file size limit (subdirectory CLAUDE.md and path-scoped rules)
facts.behavior: When a subdirectory CLAUDE.md or on-demand rules file is over a per-file limit, Claude receives only the start of it, ending with a note telling Claude to read the rest with the Read tool. Limit: 40,000 characters on 200K context window; 200,000 characters on Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 at 1M context, 150,000 characters on later models at 1M.
facts.limits: Applies to subdirectory CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md and their @imports, rules in a subdirectory's .claude/rules/, and path-scoped rules in project .claude/rules/ or ~/.claude/rules/. Not applied before v2.1.309. Each rules file counts separately.
facts.citation: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md (Claude ignores the end of my subdirectory CLAUDE.md)

facts.behavior: Block-level HTML comments (<!-- maintainer notes -->) in CLAUDE.md files are stripped before the content is injected into Claude's context, so they cost no context tokens.
facts.limits: Comments inside code blocks are preserved. Visible when the file is opened with the Read tool. Doc states this for CLAUDE.md files; not stated for rules files.

facts.behavior: CLAUDE.md files can import additional files using @path/to/import syntax; imported files are expanded and loaded into context alongside the importing CLAUDE.md. Relative and absolute paths allowed; relative resolve against the importing file. Recursive imports to a maximum depth of four hops. Spaces in paths need a backslash; quoted paths are not imported. Import parsing skips code spans and fenced code blocks (wrap in backticks to mention literally).
facts.limits: Imports organize but do not reduce context cost. Max depth four hops.

facts.behavior: An import in a project-level memory file is external when its path resolves outside the working directory. First time Claude Code encounters external imports in a project it shows an approval dialog listing the files; if declined, imports stay disabled and the dialog does not appear again.
facts.limits: User-scope files (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, ~/.claude/rules/) load imports without the dialog, except in Cowork desktop sessions, which skip user-scope imports resolving outside the working directory and skip a symlinked/hard-linked ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md.

facts.behavior: Private per-project preferences at project root; loads alongside CLAUDE.md and is treated the same way, appended after CLAUDE.md in each directory.
facts.limits: Not auto-added to .gitignore (user must add it), except with CLAUDE_CODE_NEW_INIT=1 where /init personal option does it. Exists only in the worktree where created. Skipped if local is excluded from --setting-sources (for additional directories).
facts.citation: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md (Import additional files; Load from additional directories)

facts.behavior: --add-dir gives access to additional directories; by default their CLAUDE.md files are NOT loaded. Set CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1 to load CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules/*.md, and CLAUDE.local.md from them.
facts.limits: Off by default; AGENTS.md in added directories does not load.
facts.citation: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md (Load from additional directories; Where AGENTS.md differs)

facts.behavior: Markdown files in project .claude/rules/ are discovered recursively (subdirectories allowed), one topic per file. Rules without paths frontmatter are loaded at launch with the same priority as .claude/CLAUDE.md. Rules load every session or when matching files are opened.
facts.limits: Project rules skipped if project is excluded from --setting-sources (before v2.1.211, on-demand rules loaded anyway). For task-specific instructions not needed always, docs recommend skills instead.

facts.behavior: YAML frontmatter paths field scopes a rule to matching files. A path-scoped rule loads when Claude uses Read, Write, or Edit on a matching file, or views a matching file with a Bash command that counts as a read (cat/head on a single file). Works through symlinked project paths. Patterns are relative to the rule's base directory (project rules: directory containing the .claude folder; user rules: session primary working directory). Accepts YAML list or comma-separated string; brace expansion supported.
facts.limits: Not loaded at launch; not loaded for a sibling git worktree unless Claude Code is started there or moved with /cd. Brace expansion budget: 1,000 expanded patterns and 4 MiB per rule's paths list; over-budget patterns used unexpanded (literal braces match nothing). Invalid '[' patterns match nothing. Subject to the on-demand per-file size limit. Compaction: reload on demand, a path-scoped rule that hasn't matched since is not present.
facts.citation: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md (Path-specific rules; Instructions seem lost after /compact)

facts.behavior: paths is the only field Claude Code reads from a rule; any other field is ignored without an error. Frontmatter is removed before the rule loads into context.
facts.limits: If the YAML does not parse, frontmatter is ignored and the rule loads as if it had no paths (so it becomes always-loaded); claude --debug shows the parse error.

facts.behavior: .claude/rules/ supports symlinks (files or directories); circular symlinks are detected and handled gracefully. A symlink whose target is outside the working directory is treated like an external import: not loaded until external imports are approved for the project, and then only rules without a paths field load. Approval asked once per project at session start.
facts.limits: Symlinks to network paths (UNC \\server\share, /net, /Network) are not followed and do not load. Edit/Write tools refuse to write through a CLAUDE.md symlink and direct Claude to the target. ~/.claude/rules/ avoids approval.
facts.citation: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md (Share rules across projects with symlinks; Share one file with other coding tools)

facts.behavior: Personal rules apply to every project on the machine. Loaded before project rules, so project rules appear later in context. Neither overrides the other.
facts.limits: If user and project rules conflict, Claude may follow either.

facts.behavior: Organization-wide CLAUDE.md at /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/CLAUDE.md (macOS), /etc/claude-code/CLAUDE.md (Linux/WSL), C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\CLAUDE.md (Windows). Applies to all users on the machine in any repository; loads before user and project CLAUDE.md. Cannot be excluded with claudeMdExcludes.
facts.limits: Guidance only, not a hard enforcement layer; enforce with managed settings such as permissions.deny, sandbox.enabled. If a session starts with CLAUDE.md loading turned off altogether, managed content is not loaded either.

facts.behavior: Puts managed CLAUDE.md content directly inside managed-settings.json instead of a separate file; same precedence as managed CLAUDE.md (loads before user and project).
facts.limits: Honored only in managed and policy settings; setting claudeMd in user, project, or local settings has no effect.

facts.behavior: Skips specific CLAUDE.md or rules files by path or glob, matched against absolute file paths. Configurable at user, project, local, or managed policy layer; arrays merge across layers. For symlinked rules, a pattern matching either the .claude/rules path or link target excludes it (from v2.1.239).
facts.limits: Cannot exclude a managed CLAUDE.md.

facts.behavior: By default Claude reads AGENTS.md only when there is no CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md or CLAUDE.local.md in the working directory or above (excluding ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, managed CLAUDE.md, and .claude/rules/, which don't count). If both exist, only CLAUDE.md files are read. A CLAUDE.md that imports AGENTS.md includes it. Setting Project instructions via /config (or pluginConfigs cc-plugin-agents-md@builtin): claude-md-or-agents-md (default), claude-md-and-agents-md, claude-md, managed-only.
facts.limits: Requires v2.1.277+. Not read: AGENTS.local.md, AGENTS.override.md, anything under .agents/. AGENTS.md read via the setting does not fire InstructionsLoaded hooks, is not loaded from --add-dir directories, and external @imports load without prompt only if previously approved. managed-only leaves out project/local/user CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules/ and AGENTS.md at launch (subdirectory CLAUDE.md and path-scoped rules still load on demand). Adding CLAUDE.local.md stops AGENTS.md being read by default.
facts.citation: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md (AGENTS.md; Choose which instruction files load)

facts.behavior: Generates a starting CLAUDE.md: Claude analyzes the codebase and creates a file with build commands, test instructions, and project conventions it discovers. If a CLAUDE.md already exists, /init suggests improvements rather than overwriting it. Reads other tools' instruction files (.cursor/rules/, .cursorrules, .github/copilot-instructions.md; with CLAUDE_CODE_NEW_INIT=1 also AGENTS.md, .devin/rules/, .windsurf/rules/, .windsurfrules, .clinerules). With CLAUDE_CODE_NEW_INIT=1 it is an interactive multi-phase flow asking which artifacts to set up (CLAUDE.md, skills, hooks), exploring via a subagent and presenting a reviewable proposal before writing.
facts.limits: Generates a starting point only; refine with instructions Claude wouldn't discover on its own.
facts.citation: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md (Set up a project CLAUDE.md; Migrate instructions from other tools)

facts.behavior: Brings a supported coding agent's configuration into Claude Code: appends a one-time copy of instruction files such as AGENTS.md to the matching CLAUDE.md and carries over MCP servers, commands, subagents, and skills.
facts.limits: One-time copy, not a live link.

facts.behavior: Run '/doctor prompt-audit' to have Claude check instruction files for outdated or conflicting content: instructions written for older models, references to files or commands that don't exist, and files that contradict each other. Produces a report of findings with proposed edits; nothing changes until you ask Claude to apply them. Default scope: CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, AGENTS.md, plus rules, skills, commands, subagents, output styles under .claude/ and ~/.claude/. A path argument audits one file or directory.
facts.limits: Requires v2.1.283+; runs through the bundled /claude-api skill and is unavailable if that skill is off via skillOverrides or disableBundledSkills. Report-only, on demand.

facts.behavior: The /doctor checkup proposes trims for a checked-in CLAUDE.md: it cuts content Claude can derive from the codebase (directory layouts, dependency lists, architecture overviews) and keeps pitfalls, rationale, and conventions that differ from tool defaults.
facts.limits: Proposes trims only; the memory page gives no further /doctor detail (see commands page, not fetched).

facts.behavior: Lists CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, and other memory file locations across user and project scopes (including entries for files that don't exist yet), toggles auto memory on or off, offers to open the auto memory folder. Selecting a file opens it in your editor (creating it first if missing). Also lists a directly-read AGENTS.md (v2.1.280+).
facts.limits: Use /context (not /memory) to check which CLAUDE.md and rules files loaded at launch.

facts.behavior: Run /context and check the list under Memory files to verify which CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, and rules files loaded at launch. If one is missing there, Claude can't see it.
facts.limits: Subdirectory CLAUDE.md files do not appear because they load on demand.
facts.citation: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md (Set up a project CLAUDE.md; Claude isn't following my CLAUDE.md)

facts.feature: Instruction-file diagnostics (/status warning, notice, InstructionsLoaded hook)
facts.behavior: Startup and /status warning for over-length instruction files; an 'Instruction file not loaded' notice may appear (explained in errors doc). The InstructionsLoaded hook logs which CLAUDE.md and rules files are loaded, when, and why. claude --debug shows rule frontmatter parse errors.
facts.limits: InstructionsLoaded does not fire for AGENTS.md read via the Project instructions setting.
facts.citation: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md (Claude isn't following my CLAUDE.md; My CLAUDE.md is too large; Rule frontmatter reference)

facts.behavior: Project-root CLAUDE.md survives compaction: after /compact, Claude re-reads it from disk and re-injects it. Nested CLAUDE.md files in subdirectories and rules with paths: frontmatter load again on demand.
facts.limits: Instructions given only in conversation are lost; nested CLAUDE.md or path-scoped rules not yet reloaded are absent until a matching file is touched. Full breakdown in context-window.md#what-survives-compaction (not fetched).

facts.feature: Auto memory: what it is and what it saves
facts.behavior: Notes Claude writes itself across sessions. Four kinds recorded as a type field in frontmatter: user, feedback, project, reference. Claude skips anything derivable from the codebase and anything CLAUDE.md files already say, and does not save every session; it decides what is worth remembering.
facts.limits: Claude-judged, not guaranteed. Machine-local: not shared across machines or cloud environments.

facts.behavior: On by default in local sessions. /memory toggle saves autoMemoryEnabled to ~/.claude/settings.json; autoMemoryEnabled can be set per project in project settings; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1 disables via env var.
facts.limits: Sessions in a self-hosted environment (outside Claude Tag) default to off. In background sessions and sessions started by another Claude Code session, the toggle can turn it off but not back on.

facts.behavior: Each project gets ~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/, with <project> derived from the git repository, so all worktrees and subdirectories of the same repo share one directory (outside git, the project root is used). autoMemoryDirectory setting relocates it (absolute path or ~/), readable from user, project, local, policy, or --settings. CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME beside CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR overrides the <project> name (v2.1.234+).
facts.limits: When set in project settings it is honored under the workspace trust rule as hooks. With permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories on, no auto memory is loaded from or saved to a directory chosen by a repository-supplied settings file.

facts.behavior: The first 200 lines of MEMORY.md, or the first 25KB, whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation; content beyond is not loaded at session start. After Claude writes to MEMORY.md, Claude Code measures it against both limits. Near a limit, it reminds Claude to shorten it (one line per entry, move detail into topic files, merge or drop stale entries). Over a limit, the write still succeeds but Claude Code returns an error telling Claude to rewrite the index, because everything past the limit is dropped on next load.
facts.limits: Applies only to MEMORY.md, not to CLAUDE.md files or topic files. Reminder and error are directed at Claude's writes; they do not truncate the file on disk.

facts.feature: Auto memory topic files and index
facts.behavior: Directory holds MEMORY.md (index, one line per memory, loaded into every session) plus one topic file per memory (e.g. user_role.md, feedback_testing.md). Topic files are not loaded at startup; Claude reads them on demand with standard file tools. Claude Code records write time in a 'modified' frontmatter field (ISO 8601) when Claude writes a memory file beginning with YAML frontmatter.
facts.limits: Topic files not in context unless Claude reads them. Not excluded from edit; plain markdown the user can edit or delete.

facts.behavior: Memory files are excluded from the cleanupPeriodDays transcript retention sweep; MEMORY.md and topic files stay until edited or deleted. The main conversation's auto memory is not loaded into subagents (exception: a fork inherits the parent conversation). A subagent's own auto memory, enabled with the subagent memory field, is a separate directory.
facts.limits: Subagent memory details are on the sub-agents page (not fetched).

facts.feature: Asking Claude to remember vs CLAUDE.md
facts.behavior: When you ask Claude to remember something (e.g. 'always use pnpm'), Claude saves it to auto memory. To add to CLAUDE.md instead, ask directly ('add this to CLAUDE.md') or edit via /memory. 'Saved N memories' / 'Recalled N memories' messages appear in the interface.
facts.limits: Default destination of 'remember' is auto memory, not CLAUDE.md.

facts.behavior: @ file references add CLAUDE.md in the file's directory and parent directories to context. Included file content respects the Read tool token limit (25,000 tokens default); a text file larger than 256KB isn't included.
facts.limits: PreToolUse hooks don't run for @ inclusions; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_MENTIONS=1 (v2.1.299+, ignored in project/local settings) or Read deny rules stop inclusion.

facts.behavior: Claude Code works in any directory, e.g. a notes vault; the .claude/ directory and CLAUDE.md sit alongside other tools' config directories without conflict. Claude reads files fresh on each tool call, so it sees edits made in another application on next read.
facts.limits: None stated.

facts.behavior: Auto memory is shared across worktrees of the same repo. Gitignored CLAUDE.local.md exists only in the worktree where created. claude --worktree <name> creates an isolated parallel session; .worktreeinclude and cleanup are covered on the worktrees page.
facts.limits: The common-workflows page does not detail .worktreeinclude; worktrees page not fetched. Path-scoped rules for a sibling worktree need the session started there or /cd.
